choice_note_from_source: Two and Three Mark has each one choice question.
Four marks has Four choice questions.
Five marks has Two choice questions.
assembly_principles: The uploaded chapter-wise weightage controls chapter allocation.
Question numbering/order is a separate assembly concern and must be based on an approved paper template/model-paper structure, not inferred from chapter row order.
Each selected item must match the exact chapter and mark requirement of its blueprint row.
A zero-allocation chapter is not selected for the final mock.
RTC, quote-from-memory, extract/context and similar formats are internal question-format tags; they do not create extra blueprint rows.

Historical questions must retain provenance and may be selected only when the assembled paper's use policy permits them; otherwise use them for recurrence/calibration and select original practice items.
Do not reuse the same canonical question in both a primary item and its choice.
Choices must be equivalent in mark value and appropriate to the same blueprint slot.
Final release requires exact totals of 47 questions and 100 marks.
